# The Leporii
The Leporii have many names, but are appropriately referred to as just "moths" by most crewmembers. You're free to call them what you like, just be respectful.
They can eat cotton-based items, but virtually none of the food that others would consider "edible". They prefer a somewhat lower temperature range than most. Their hemolymph cannot be metabolised from from iron like normal blood.
They're able to move more effectively if there is no gravity on the station, but they still can't move without equipment when floating out in space. They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less cold damage[/color] but [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage, catch on fire more easily, and take 350% more fire damage than other species.[/color]
They are able to fly short distances, allowing them to move around areas quickly. They can fly up to [color=yellow]4[/color] times in a row, and will regain one 'charge' of this ability every [color=yellow]45[/color] seconds.
